description: The people who OPTED IN to marketing messages from a Facebook Page — their subscription tokens, the only address a paid Messenger marketing message can go to (there is no "message everyone"). Also reports whether Messenger marketing is turned on for this Meta connection. It is an OPTIONAL add-on, not part of the default Meta connect: when it is off, the Messenger marketing tools answer with the link that turns it on (Workspace > Connectors > Meta > Enable Messenger marketing), never with 'reconnect Meta'; Meta then asks the user to confirm the Pages and pick an ad account, and lists only ones their own Facebook profile fully controls. Free.

customAudienceIds.description: comma-separated Messenger custom audience ids to filter by

pageId.description: Facebook Page id (from list_meta_pages); defaults to the one shared Page

title: List Messenger marketing-message subscribers
